# Real screenshot corpus for skill outcome fixtures

Captured from Luda 0.3.3 (`eb268e8`) on 2026-09-21, using real XFCE Appearance and Thunar in an ordinary `ubuntu` account with a private Xvfb display, private DBus session and temporary HOME. The shared `:1` display was never accessed. These are evaluator fixture assets, not production qualification or live evaluated-agent acceptance results.

`manifest.json` supplies five screenshot/state combinations to the six-case simulator. All PNGs are unmodified `desktop_observe` screenshots. Separate `*.observe.json` and `*.inspect.json` files retain original responses. `provenance.json` records independent `xfconf-query` applied-theme readings and screenshot hashes. `*.independent-selection.json` records a separate system-Python AT-SPI traversal of selected objects. The reviewer inspected all five images: the dark desktop remains present around a white list and light controls until activation actually applies Greybird-dark; only then does the application list/control interior become dark. Thunar captures show the same unopened file before and after highlighting.

Greybird 3.23.3-1 was extracted from the official Ubuntu package into the temporary HOME, never installed globally. The package URL and SHA-256 are recorded in provenance. No theme assets are redistributed here beyond the screenshots. `capture-session.py` is the archival acquisition program with session-specific paths; it is not a portable command or an evaluated-agent tool. It must only be adapted under a private display/profile, never executed in a user's desktop session. Prerequisites included the disposable `/workspace/Selection trial/target.txt` containing `Disposable selection fixture.\n` and a worktree-local Python venv.

`runner.json` records successful bounded completion and no surviving tagged processes. The initial capture failed because Thunar Icon view did not expose file children through accessibility. Its log is preserved; switching to the observed Details view recovered the capture. GTK accessibility warnings and the missing optional thumbnailer are retained in the final log. No evaluated-agent test results are claimed by this capture. Selection and activation receipts, including unchanged re-selection, remain separate from the independent theme oracle.
